english.synthetic: Written for tests. No real person.

segments.text: Good day, Mrs. Popescu. Thank you for finding time for the call.
Good day. I would like to discuss the offer for licenses and the delivery term.
Our offer is for 25 licenses, at a total price of 12500 lei per year.
That's fine, but we need the invoice by the end of the month.
I will issue the invoice by November 30th and send it by email.
Thank you, Mihai. Mrs. Popescu, can you send us the list of users?
Yes, I'll send it by Tuesday.
We can do the installation during the first week of December.
Perfect. We also need a training for our team.
I can organize the training, but we need to set a date.
We will set the training date after we receive the list of users.
Agreed. And please send us the signed contract.
I'll send it to you tomorrow.
Thank you, have a good day.
